notes.title: Bug Fixes and Quality Boost!
notes.notes:
Hey detectives! 🕵️‍♀️ We’ve heard your requests and concerns, and we're ready to deliver the first batch of fixes! Here’s what’s new in this update:

🛠️ We’ve added and double-checked every piece of content—everything’s in place and ready for you to uncover. 

🛠️ We made sure that the game can be completed without any issues, so no more getting stuck midway through the investigation! 

🛠️ No more 30 FPS limits. Enjoy that smooth frame rate! 

🛠️ You asked, we listened. Hit `C` and scroll your mouse wheel to adjust the camera speed—perfect for getting those cinematic shots or just taking in the atmosphere.

And don't forget, if you think the game looks even better now, feel free to check out the updated screenshots and videos on the store page! 📸🎬

Happy investigating, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t yet! 💙👀
